hooks.name: shp-gofmt-on-save
hooks.description: Formats the saved Go file with gofmt. gofmt only rewrites the file when formatting changes.

hooks.name: shp-go-vet-on-stop
hooks.description: Runs go vet on the whole module when the agent finishes a turn. Requires a go.mod in the workspace root.

hooks.name: shp-go-test-on-stop
hooks.description: Runs the fast test suite (-short) when the agent finishes a turn. Requires a go.mod in the workspace root.

hooks.name: shp-golangci-lint-on-stop
hooks.description: Optional. Enable when golangci-lint v2 is installed.

hooks.name: shp-go-test-race-on-stop
hooks.description: Optional. The race detector needs cgo and a C toolchain, usually unavailable on locked-down Windows machines.

hooks.name: shp-govulncheck-on-stop
hooks.description: Optional. Enable when govulncheck is installed and the vulnerability database is reachable.

hooks.name: shp-review-after-spec-task
hooks.description: Optional. After each spec task, reviews the changed Go files with the shp-go-review checklist. Uses extra agent credits.

action.prompt: Use the shp-go-review skill to review the Go files changed by the spec task that just finished. Report findings in the skill's output format. Do not modify files.
